sanskrit_verse:
दत्त्वा र्णं पाटयेल् लेख्यं शुद्ध्यै वान्यत् तु कारयेत् ।
साक्षिमच् च भवेद् यद् वा तद् दातव्यं ससाक्षिकम् ॥
transliteration: dattvā rṇaṃ pāṭayel lekhyaṃ śuddhyai vānyat tu kārayet / sākṣimac ca bhaved yad vā tad dātavyaṃ sasākṣikam //
sph_interpretive_translation: Having received a debt, one shall cancel the written record for purification; otherwise, another arrangement must be executed with full witness validation. Whatever involves testimony must be given along with witnesses.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises through witnessed acknowledgment of obligation fulfillment
Causation is established via documented discharge of liability
Capacity-based responsibility requires conscious completion and verification
Restoration logic demands removal of encumbrance upon repayment
Consciousness alignment occurs when all parties recognize resolution
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that financial obligations once discharged must be formally annulled in records. In absence of direct cancellation, alternate settlements require verified witnessing to maintain legal purity. The threshold of responsibility lies in both execution and attestation by qualified observers.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that repayment leads to release from indebtedness. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential steps: payment, acknowledgment, record cancellation or restructuring under witness. Proportional responsibility aligns with actual completion, not intent or fault. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that truth itself restores balance without imposition of penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Activate consciousness_realignment_session among debtor-creditor-witness triad post-resolution
Execute integrity_reintegration_ceremony confirming mutual recognition of closure
Enforce capacity_restoration_audit ensuring no residual energetic or social liability remains
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law flows directly from His Avataric Intelligence. Justice operates solely for restoration, reintegration, and consciousness realignment. There is no punishment—only completion. Reality responds to truth. Consciousness is the ultimate judge.
